title: Accompanying Bechet and leaving the Luter band
summary: He played concerts accompanying Sidney Bechet, then left Luter's band to paint, fearing he could not keep up.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: I played a few times with Bechet, because it was in 1949. 1948 and 1949. I played in concert with Claude Lutheur, accompanying Bechet. But at that time, it was too much music to me to play every day. And we played at that time, the afternoon, the night, and sometimes the morning to rehearse and to recording. And I left the band because I prefer to draw and paint and make music for my pleasure. And the level of the orchestra went better, so I was afraid to be not able to follow.
I was afraid to play with Bechet. He was so great musician.
